name: Qi-Laced Thread
description: Lace a thread of soul force with a breath of qi so it hums at both a soul and a body that touch it.

name: Joint Cinch
description: Close a cinch of soul force and qi round a target so its body and mind are held together.

name: Dual Barb
description: Send a barb of soul force and qi along a laid line to strike body and soul at once.

name: Coupled Tether
description: Couple a tether of soul force to a band of qi that presses on both will and flesh.

name: Layered Veilwork
description: Wear a veil of qi over a veil of soul force so a blow to either meets both.

name: Unison Step
description: Pull the body along a thread of soul force while qi drives the legs in time.

name: Ensnaring Current
description: Plant a snare of soul force fed by qi that closes on body and soul together when crossed.

name: Twofold Taint
description: Leave a taint of soul force and qi that sours a caught foe's breath and focus together.

name: Binding Union
description: Join soul force and qi in a wide lattice that holds both the body and the will of all inside.

name: Unison Gaol
description: streams: Soul + Qi; pour soul force and qi through one snare so a caught foe is bound in body and will at once.

name: Joined Thread
description: Run a thread joining soul and Core so a stir at its far end is felt in both.

name: Joint Noose
description: Throw a noose of soul force backed by Core qi that holds the body and mind of a target.

name: Backed Barb
description: Back a barb of soul force with Core qi so it drives past a guard into body and soul.

name: Joined Guard
description: Join a guard of soul force to a shell of Core qi about the self.

name: Dual Hobble
description: Hobble a target's stride with qi while a matching hobble of soul force slows its thought.

name: Pressing Union
description: Press Core qi and soul force together on a target until its strength and will sag as one.

name: Joined Recoil
description: Throw a hostile blow back along its line with the shell of Core qi and the veil of soul force together.

name: Core-Driven Slip
description: Slip the body along a thread of soul force driven by a burst of Core qi.

name: Welded Snare
description: Weld a snare of soul force to a plate of Core qi so it closes on body and soul and does not give.

name: Deep Contagion
description: Seed a taint of soul force in qi so it spreads through a caught foe's body and soul alike.

name: Union Lattice
description: Raise a lattice of soul force and Core qi across a wide span that closes on whatever enters it.

name: Conjoined Maw
description: streams: Soul + Qi; close one great maw of soul force and Core qi on a foe and grind body and soul together.
